Why Now

The category is moving from the shadows into regulated care.

For years this category has run on imported vials, private groups and offshore checkouts. That is closing fast. A $10 million Federal Court penalty in 2019. Compounding exemptions stripped from GLP-1s in 2024. Unapproved peptides now a formal TGA compliance priority in 2026.

Every one of those actions removes an operator who could never operate in the open. The lawful version of this just sold for over a billion dollars. We are building the next one, properly, from day one.

What We Need From You

Simple, consistent, authentic participation.

First 90 days

Weekly story content, plus one feed post per month for the first three months. The goal is to introduce the partnership naturally and build familiarity with your audience.

From month four

Fortnightly story updates. Simple check-ins, questions and answers, behind-the-scenes updates, or other natural touchpoints that keep the audience connected to the journey.

One category, one voice

You do not endorse a competing peptide, telehealth or longevity clinic brand for the term. In return, you become a genuine category partner rather than one of several brands mentioned across the year.

Speak from your own experience

Keep the content personal: your own journey and how you are feeling. No therapeutic claims, no named compounds, no outcome promises, with clear partnership disclosure. We will brief you before anything goes live.

Next Steps

If there is a fit, we make it real.

This is an introduction, not a signed agreement, and this offer is being made ahead of our public launch. The next step is a short call to confirm the equity allocation, partnership terms and launch date.
